script_text: Stop, Cancer — the stars are not whispering; they are shoving a career door open. Your Moon-ruled water nature is lit by Mars in your 10th House sextiling Jupiter in your 1st House, while the Moon in the 12th House applies to a conjunction with the Sun in Gemini. This is bold visibility, not reckless; stop hiding ambition behind private worries. In love, if you’re taken, avoid turning one vague text into a loyalty test; say the tender truth before bedtime. If you’re single, a steady Capricorn or practical earth-sign energy may appear through friends or a group chat. Career and money: Jupiter’s 1st House luck sextiles Mars in the 10th, so pitch, negotiate, or ask for the higher rate; a client can say yes fast. Avoid overpromising while Mercury works behind the scenes in your 12th House, but a late-night message brings a useful connection. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
